architecture: Original Nunchi Oracle and Crypto Rust sources compiled to WASM over an application-provided in-memory StateStore.
keys: Public deterministic demo keys; no physical-device identity attestation.
scope: Robotics, telemetry, scheduling and costs are simulated. SDK signatures, Oracle record IDs, writes, reads and queries execute locally. No validators, consensus, persistent QMDB, hardware attestation or proof of physical delivery.

payload.cost_basis: Application-defined operating time and electricity estimates
